In Episode 1 (Beyond Chatbots - The Anatomy of an Autonomous Agent), we explored: Here is a natural, 3-sentence recap the hosts can use tomorrow morning:

"Yesterday, we kicked off the series by moving beyond basic chatbots to explore the core anatomy of autonomous agents—systems designed not just to talk, but to reason, plan, and execute multi-step tasks. We broke down how these agents operate like a loop of perception, thought, and action, using tools and memory to solve complex problems independently. It was a foundational look at the shift from AI that simply answers questions to AI that actually gets work done."
